name: Online course (MOOC)
one_line: Self-paced study bought or enrolled on a course platform: a downloaded lesson series with captions, exercise notebooks, a completion certificate and an order confirmation — course-shaped material that usually carries no term and whose institution evidence is a provider, not a registrar.
node_test: Passes on three of the licensed differences, not on work types or extensions. (1) Detection signals differ: the dominant evidence here is a sequence-numbered lesson series in audio_video plus a caption sibling — 00 says audio and video files should yield "duration, container and codec metadata, creation time, embedded tags, subtitles or captions where present" — and provider-plus-completion language, none of which the coursework template's registrar/term/course-code signals reach. (2) The recommended dimensions differ: term is dropped by default because self-paced platform study frequently produces no term evidence at all, and 00's term rule admits only dedicated patterns. (3) The privacy contour differs: the bulk of this material is published third-party media carrying no personal content, while the personal residue is a named certificate, an order receipt and an enrollment mail rather than coursework's grades and rosters.

deterministic: a course-provider gazetteer hit (R4's content, matched at a word boundary — 00: "It should use word-boundary matching rather than substring matching.") in a high-weight zone together with self-paced-study language describing the document itself (enrollment, module, lesson, course completion — proposed_context_terms, not 00's five)

a sequence-numbered lesson filename shape (an ordinal pair before a lesson title) recurring across sibling files in one directory, where those siblings are audio_video or presentation and an embedded title tag repeats one course title across them

a caption or subtitle file whose stem matches a sibling lesson media file's stem — the same evidence 00 expects inside the media ("subtitles or captions where present"), detached into its own text-bearing file
certificate-of-completion language in the title zone naming both a provider and a course title, with no licensing-board, credit-hour or renewal language present

the Academic schema's own rule with provider-shaped institution evidence: "a course-code pattern together with academic context" where the co-occurring institution token resolves to a provider or platform rather than to registrar, enrollment or transcript language

an order-confirmation or enrollment slot pair in a labelled document or mail header (order identifier plus a course title line item), which 00's email extraction surfaces as a structured slot rather than prose
needs_llm: a lecture caption transcript whose only content is subject-matter prose — the model must decide whether a recurring phrase is the course title or merely the topic, and must return unknown when it cannot cite a title-zone or embedded-tag occurrence
a downloaded PDF that reads equally as a course reading and as a research paper, where no provider or lesson-sequence evidence exists on the file itself
an OCR'd platform dashboard where progress language is present but no course-code-shaped token and no provider name appear
an archive whose members mix exercise notebooks, slide decks and a certificate: is the shared explanation one purchased course, or a code project that happens to contain teaching material?
a lesson media file whose filename is opaque and whose only signal is an embedded title tag in a language the deterministic provider and lesson-sequence catalogues do not cover
never_alone: a provider or university name alone — 00 names this exact ambiguity and names the provider role inside it: "A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization."

source_type audio_video alone, or a video extension alone — a downloaded film, a podcast episode and a screen recording are the same shape; 00: the engine should "treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning"
a sequence-numbered filename alone: a camera burst, a scanned book, a ripped album and a lesson series all produce ordinal-prefixed siblings
a bulk download session alone, which is how a whole course usually arrives on disk — 00: "A session should never be treated as proof of topic"
the word Certificate alone, which equally fits a professional licence, an insurance certificate, a share certificate and a birth certificate

a week-shaped token alone as a term: 00 admits only dedicated term patterns — "Academic terms such as Spring 2025, AY 2024-25, and Michaelmas Term 2024 require dedicated patterns rather than generic parsing."
a bare 4-digit number alone, which may be a course identifier, a video bitrate, an order number or a year
a parent folder named after a provider alone — folder context is a clue, and 00 requires existing structure be read as evidence of habit rather than silently reinterpreted

grouping_reasons: one purchased or enrolled course on one provider, across its lesson media, caption siblings, exercise files and certificate
one lesson across its media file and its caption file — a derivation pair, not a duplicate family and not a version family
one enrollment across its order confirmation, its confirmation mail and its later certificate: content-incoherent, purpose-coherent
a bulk download that brought a whole course down at once, which enters only as the possible-grade clue 00 allows and never as proof of topic

template.why: Same parent-context rule as the schema's default template — 00: "a parent dimension should provide the context required to understand the child" — so the provider (held in school, per this row's roster hint) precedes the course, and the course precedes the work type: Certificate or Week 4 Quiz is unintelligible until the course is known. term is dropped from the recommended order rather than reordered, because self-paced platform study routinely produces no term evidence at all and 00 admits no fuzzy substitute for it; a level no fact can fill is exactly what 00 warns against — "It should recommend flattening when a dimension does not materially improve retrieval." OPTIONAL BRANCH PATTERN: where a provider runs dated cohorts and a dedicated term pattern actually matches, term may be inserted between school and subject, restoring the schema's default order. time_first is false for the reason 00 gives document domains: "For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders." All three dimensions are destination-eligible fields the Academic schema declares; instructor is excluded because it is not destination-eligible. This is a recommendation — the user may reverse, remove, add or flatten any level, and a provider-flat course-first order is a reasonable choice for someone who studies with one provider only.

collides_with.signal: both are lecture-and-exercise material carrying a course title and a work type, and one evidence item — the word Lecture beside a course-shaped token — supports either. The discriminating evidence: coursework needs registrar-, enrollment- or term-side evidence naming the holder's own institution, or a dedicated term pattern; this template needs provider-plus-self-paced evidence — a course-provider hit with completion, module or enrollment language, or a lesson-ordinal series with a matching caption sibling. A university that appears as the course provider is the trap 00 names by role, and neither side may take a bare institution name.

the closest neighbour on the roster: both are provider-run courses ending in a completion certificate, and a certificate PDF is one evidence item that supports either. The discriminating evidence: continuing education carries credit-hour, accreditation, licensing-board or renewal-cycle language tying the course to a professional obligation; this template carries none of that and instead carries platform artifacts — a lesson-ordinal media series, caption siblings, a course-order receipt. Where a file carries both, neither side takes the item. Whether these are one organizational situation is recorded in open_question.

a completion certificate and a professional licence are the same document shape, and the holder's name plus a credential identifier is one evidence item supporting either. The discriminating evidence: a licence or certification carries an expiry or renewal date, an issuing authority with a registry, and a credential number that verifies against that registry; a course completion carries a provider, a course title and a course-completion verification id with no expiry.

an exercise notebook and an experiment notebook are the same source_type with the same cell structure, and the notebook itself is one evidence item supporting either. The discriminating evidence, 00's own: code needs "local structural evidence, including repository roots and package files" — a manifest, a repository marker, a project identifier; the course side needs a numbered exercise prompt inside the notebook plus sibling course artifacts (a lesson series, slides, a certificate) with no repository markers present.

sensitivity_why: The bulk of this material is published third-party course media that carries no personal content at all — the privacy contrast with the coursework situation, whose grades and rosters dominate. The personal residue is narrow but real: the completion certificate carries the holder's full name and a verification identifier, the order confirmation carries a purchase record, and the enrollment mail is a mail file, which 00 requires be handled "while treating addresses and message content as potentially sensitive". Which handling class applies is P7's and is not set here.
open_question: Two forks, both Joseph's. (1) One file can name two institutions — the platform that hosted the course and the university that authored it — and only one canonical key, school, is available to hold either; this row follows its roster hint and puts the provider in school, so the authoring university currently has nowhere to land and is recorded as a must_not_conclude rather than a fact. Minting a second institution key would be a canonical-field change, not a template's decision. (2) academic.online-course and academic.continuing-education may be one organizational situation: both are provider-run, certificate-terminated and usually termless, and the split rests entirely on whether a professional obligation (credit hours, a licensing board, a renewal cycle) is present. If Joseph reads that as a value distinction rather than a situational one, one of the two rows should be withdrawn at R1c rather than both padded.
